nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address; mutated in _transferStandard, _transferNoTax and takeFees.
Mapping of last transaction timestamp per address used for the 3 minute buy cooldown check.
Current transfer tax fee applied on buys or sells; set inside _transfer.
Payable marketing wallet that receives ETH swapped from collected tokens.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and liquidity additions.
Address of the SOC/WETH liquidity pair created in the constructor.
Flag controlling whether trading is enabled; toggled by enbaleTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swaps.
Flag enabling/disabling automatic contract token swaps; toggled by toggleSwap.
Flag enabling the 3 minute cooldown between buys; toggled by toggleTransferDelay.
Minimum contract token balance that triggers an automatic swap for ETH.
Maximum amount allowed per transaction for non-exempt accounts.
Maximum token balance allowed per wallet for non-exempt accounts.
Public blacklist mapping of addresses blocked from transferring.
Fixed total token supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping of accounts exempt from tax, max tx and max wallet restrictions.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Core private transfer routine applying limits, cooldown, blacklist, tax and triggering contract swaps.
Private function that splits tokens, swaps them for ETH via the router and adds liquidity; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private function forwarding accumulated ETH to the marketing address via transfer.
Private function that approves and adds token/ETH liquidity to the Uniswap pair.
Only-owner function that manually swaps the full contract token balance for ETH.
Only-owner function that enables or disables trading.
Only-owner function that blacklists an array of addresses.
Only-owner function distributing untaxed tokens to a list of recipients.
Private transfer path that deducts fees via takeFees before crediting the recipient.
Internal fee-free transfer path updating balances directly.
Internal function computing the fee amount and crediting it to the contract.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that transfers and decrements the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer.
Empty receive function allowing the contract to accept ETH from swaps.
Only-owner ownership transfer that also migrates fee exemption flags.
Only-owner setter for buy and sell tax fees.
Only-owner toggle for automatic contract swap behavior.
Only-owner setter for the maximum transaction amount.
Only-owner setter for fee exemption of a given holder.
Only-owner toggle of the anti-snipe transfer delay.
Private helper writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Private dispatcher choosing between taxed and untaxed transfer paths.
Only-owner setter for the maximum wallet size.
Only-owner setter for the minimum swap token threshold.
Only-owner function that removes an address from the blacklist.
Caller address used for transfers, approvals and owner checks.
Block timestamp used for cooldown checks, deadline arguments and last-tx bookkeeping.
Transaction origin used as the key for the anti-snipe cooldown check.
External call to the Uniswap router swapping contract tokens for ETH.
External payable call to the Uniswap router adding ETH liquidity.
Native ETH transfer to the marketing wallet; forwards all gas and can fail.
Fee math (mul/div/add/sub) computing fee amounts and net transfers.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer and the ERC20 entry points.

Array of recipient addresses for the airdrop loop.
Token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
Local holding the contract token balance used to decide automatic swapping.
Local boolean deciding whether fees are applied in _transfer.
Local boolean indicating the contract holds enough tokens to swap.
Local portion of tokens swapped for ETH (85 percent).
Local portion of tokens reserved for liquidity (15 percent).
Local snapshot of the contract ETH balance before the swap.
Local net amount credited to the recipient after fees.

edges.reason: User-controlled caller address flows into the core transfer routine.
User-supplied amount is used in balance and limit checks.
Sender address is used for exemption, blacklist and pair checks.
Recipient address is used for exemption, blacklist and wallet size checks.
tx.origin controls the anti-snipe cooldown branch, a timestamp/origin dependency.
block.timestamp gates the 3 minute cooldown requirement.
Timestamp is stored keyed by tx.origin, making state dependent on origin.
Block timestamp is written into the _lastTX cooldown mapping.
_transfer writes timestamps into _lastTX for origin and recipient.
Transfer routine ultimately mutates balances via the internal transfer paths.
tradingOpen is required before non-exempt transfers proceed.
Amount is bounded by _maxTxAmount.
Recipient balance is bounded by _maxWalletSize.
Blacklist mapping gates the transfer.
transferDelay flag enables the cooldown check.
Contract balance is compared against _swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swaps.
Automatic swap external interactions are invoked from the transfer path.
ETH forwarding to the marketing wallet is triggered inside the transfer path.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
Buy/sell branch selection writes the active _taxFee.
Contract token balance local drives the swap decision in _transfer.
canSwap guards the automatic external swap call.
takeFee boolean selects the taxed or untaxed path.
Public transfer calls the private _transfer.
transferFrom calls the private _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom reads and decreases _allowances.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
Caller becomes the spender when applying an allowance.
Taxed transfers route through _transferStandard.
Fee-free transfers route through _transferNoTax.
_transferStandard computes fees via takeFees.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient balances.
_transferNoTax updates balances directly without fees.
Net amount after fees is credited in _transferStandard.
Fee amount is computed with mul/div arithmetic.
takeFees credits the fee to the contract balance.
Active tax fee multiplies the amount in fee arithmetic.
manualswap invokes the swapping routine that performs external calls.
External router swap call executed from swapTokensForEth.
swapTokensForEth calls addLiquidity with the reserved portion.
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwap around the swap.
Router instance is used for the swap and path resolution.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
Token amount parameter drives the swap split.
ethAmt is the amountIn passed to the router swap.
liqAmt is the token amount used for liquidity.
Balance snapshot is compared after the swap to derive gained ETH.
addLiquidity performs an external payable router call.
Router is approved and used to add liquidity.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Native ETH is forwarded to the marketing address with transfer.
Marketing address is the destination of the ETH transfer.
airdrop distributes tokens through the fee-free transfer path.
Recipient array from the owner drives the airdrop loop.
Caller (owner) is the source of airdropped tokens.
onlyOwner check compares caller against owner().
Ownership transfer migrates the fee exemption flags.
setIsFeeExempt writes privileged exemption state.
setFees updates the tax fee configuration used by fee math.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold updates the auto-swap threshold.
toggleSwap flips the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxTxnAmount updates the transaction limit.
setMaxWalletSize updates the wallet limit.
toggleTransferDelay flips the cooldown flag.
enbaleTrading sets the tradingOpen flag.
blockBots adds addresses to the blacklist mapping.
unblockBot clears a blacklist entry.
receive() accepts ETH and can be re-entered by external callers during swaps.

Recipient address parameter is solely consumed by the core transfer routine.
Recipient list parameter only feeds the airdrop distribution loop.
Token amount parameter only feeds the swap routine.
Local derived from balanceOf(address(this)) driving the swap trigger in the transfer routine.
Local boolean that only selects the branch inside the transfer dispatcher.
Local flag guarding the automatic external swap invocation.
Local that becomes the amountIn of the router swap call.
Local reserved token portion passed to the liquidity addition.
Local balance snapshot used to measure the ETH gained from the router swap.
Local net amount credited by the taxed transfer path.
